svg.title: Huygens’s principle applied to a straight wavefront
svg.desc: Each point on an old straight wavefront is a source of a semicircular wavelet of radius s = vt. The new wavefront, a time t later, is the line tangent to all the wavelets, a distance s = vt ahead, and the wave moves in the direction of the arrow. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Huygens wavelets construct the next plane wavefront
All sources on the old front emit simultaneously in the same medium. Equal wavelet radii grow as vt;
their common tangent advances at the wave speed.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
